correctness.rationale: For all n>=2, good positional edges G={i:|sigma(i+1)-sigma(i)|=1}; an admissible permutation has no adjacent edges outside G. A forced set S of good edges separates into r(S) increasing-or-decreasing runs on value intervals, giving exactly 2^{r(S)}(n-|S|)! permutations. Boolean-lattice Mobius inversion and the explicit three-state (S,T) transfer yield P_1=1,P_2=4u-2u^2,P_3=2u+4u^2-2u^3, P_m=uP_{m-1}+(2u-u^2)P_{m-2}. Independent brute permutation counts n=2..8 matched the polynomial recurrence exactly (2,6,18,52,170,550,1972). This independently checked finite domain corroborates but does not replace the unlimited combinatorial proof.
